info.title: Ark API
info.description: HTTP API for the Ark presentation builder. Zod schemas in `packages/contracts/` are the source of truth; this document is generated for cross-language clients and drift checks.

afterIndex.description: Insert after this index. Omit or -1 to append.

html.description: Slide HTML (section outerHTML or inner content).

slideId.description: Optional stable slide id to assign.

notes.description: Speaker notes. Empty string clears notes.

zIndex.description: Absolute z-index to assign. Omit when using direction.

direction.description: Stack relative to siblings: "front" moves above the top sibling, "back" below the bottom.

activeSlideIndex.description: Current active slide index so the server can suggest an updated index.

get.summary: List chat messages for a deck

delete.summary: Clear chat history for a deck

post.description: Enqueue deck generation or editing. Optional `assetIds` attach uploaded deck assets to the latest user turn; requires `deckId`. Poll `GET /api/generation-jobs/{id}` until the job reaches a terminal status.

202.description: Job accepted (wire shape omits request messages and `assetIds`)

post.summary: Retry a failed or canceled job

413.description: Request body exceeds the preview session JSON size limit

get.summary: Get sandbox-rendered slide thumbnails for a deck version
get.description: Returns cached per-slide PNG URLs when ready. Missing thumbnails enqueue an async render and return `pending`. When the renderer is unavailable, returns `disabled` and clients fall back to script-stripped srcDoc thumbnails.

get.summary: Serve a cached slide thumbnail PNG

200.description: PNG image bytes with long-lived immutable cache headers

get.description: Returns pinned runtime libraries (for example reveal.js, chart.js) and their `/api/runtimes/...` asset URLs. Deck HTML must reference only approved registry paths.
Streams a vendored runtime file (JavaScript, CSS, fonts). `assetPath` may include subdirectories (for example `theme/white.css`).

200.description: Runtime asset bytes. Response includes `Cache-Control`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, and `X-Checksum-Sha256` headers.

get.summary: Proxy an allowlisted remote deck asset
get.description: Fetches a remote image, font, or stylesheet server-side when `ARK_DECK_ASSET_ALLOWLIST` includes the URL host. With no allowlist (default), returns 403.

200.description: Proxied asset bytes with `Content-Type` and `Cache-Control` headers

403.description: Host blocked or allowlist not configured
